references: Lidia Pivovarova, Tinka Rainio, and Eetu Mäkelä. Leveraging LLM-Generated Translations to Guide Verse Representation Learning in Finnic Oral Poetry. Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027.
title: FILTER verse embeddings: isolated and contextual precomputed embeddings
description: Precomputed float32, 768-dimensional embeddings from the selected verse-balanced model. Each original Parquet contains 4,275,969 occurrences identified by p_id, pos and v_id. Isolated and contextual tables cover exactly the same occurrence IDs in different row orders. The row_alignment.parquet file maps zero-based row indices; coverage.json records the audit. Original Parquet bytes are preserved. Includes source receipts, manifests and checksums. Embeddings are CC BY 4.0; original corpus identifiers and metadata retain their upstream terms.
